display_long_description:
A whole realm on your table, drawn in light.

  Vagrant is a survival RPG played on a tabletop in VR, rendered entirely in glowing vector lines, the way an old arcade monitor would
  have imagined a fantasy world. Every realm is new: hills, forests, rivers, towns and ruins, shaped from a seed the moment you start.

  YOU ARRIVE WITH NOTHING
  Pick up loose stones and fallen branches. Bump trees and boulders to gather more by hand. Craft a stone axe and a pickaxe, and the land
  opens up: timber, ore, a workbench, a forge. Build walls, doors, beds, chests, farm plots and fires wherever you like.

  STAY ALIVE
  Watch your food, water, warmth and rest. Hunt, fish from the riverbank, forage berries and cook over a campfire, and feed it wood before
  it burns down to ashes. Nights are cold and dangerous: light a fire, or pitch a tent and sleep till morning.

  MEET THE PEOPLE OF THE REALM
  Talk to innkeepers, traders, smiths, priests and villagers. Take on their troubles, trade for what you need, and listen to rumors. Some
  of them are about things nobody else has found.

  PLAY MUSIC
  Pick up a lute, flute or drum and play in the square. Townsfolk dance, and some join in on their own instruments, live and in time. A
  crowd fills you with courage: the longer you play, the tougher you become.

  MAKE FRIENDS
  Win over a stray cat with fish, or a dog with meat. Your pet follows you everywhere, even underground, and fights beside you.
